name: Spatially Cached Raytraced Ambient Occlusion
aliases: Spatial Hashing for Raytraced Ambient Occlusion
definition: An optimization for raytraced ambient occlusion where AO values are stored in spatial cells within a hashmap. Since AO is view-independent, it can be accumulated into a cell without reprojection when the camera moves.
summary: Spatially Cached Raytraced Ambient Occlusion optimizes performance by storing occlusion values in spatial hash cells, avoiding redundant ray tracing for static geometry across frames.
